description: This file defines the ErrorController class in the Goteo project, handling error-related HTTP requests such as redirecting URLs with trailing or starting slashes, and supporting legacy controller execution.

classes.name: ErrorController
classes.description: Controller handling error scenarios, including URL redirection and legacy dispatching.

methods.name: removeTrailingSlashAction
methods.description: Redirects URLs ending with a slash to the non-slash version; issues a message if the request method is POST.

methods.name: removeStartingSlashAction
methods.description: Redirects URLs starting with multiple slashes to a proper URL without multiple starting slashes.

methods.name: legacyControllerAction
methods.description: Handles legacy routing by including a dispatcher script or returning a 404 not found response.
